rounding_argument: Exact integer quotient/remainder yields nearest-even rounding of a rational at the chosen decimal exponent.
Decimal numerator/denominator digit lengths place the scaled ratio in [0.1,10); one exact comparison selects [1,10). A carry renormalizes the mantissa and exponent.

Within a sign, nearest-even rounding to a fixed number of significant digits is monotone, including decade transitions. Equal rounded strings for both closed enclosure endpoints certify the returned string for every enclosed value.
A zero result requires an exact rational or structural zero certificate. An enclosure crossing zero cannot be used as a zero certificate.
UnknownZero versus rounding Exhausted is based on the enclosures requested by this call; a finer cached nonzero sign alone does not change the coarse-search failure kind.
